O.outcome_detail: Agreement between automated and human total scores

cells.quote: To assess the credibility of its feedback, a pilot validation comparing automated scores with human ratings on 40 recordings was conducted (Section 3.5).
cells.note: The reported correlation results and mean scores are in the wiki entry but not in the supplied study-text excerpt; the quote therefore shows only the study's description of the pilot validation.

cells.quote: "Logical coherence ( r = 0.79, p < 0.001, 95% CI [0.64, 0.89]) and linguistic accuracy ( r = 0.63, p < 0.001, 95% CI [0.39, 0.78]) showed strong correlations with human ratings; delivery fluency (r = 0.45, p = 0.004, 95% CI [0.16, 0.67]) a moderate one; and information fidelity ( r = 0.12, p = 0.478, 95% CI [ −0.20, 0.41]) a weak, non-significant correlation."
cells.note: The dimension-level result is reported in the wiki entry; the supplied study-text excerpt mentions the pilot validation but does not include these statistics.
